basic_details.short_information: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has invited unmarried Indian male and female candidates to appear in an Open Recruitment Rally from 31 August 2026 to 07 September 2026 to join as Agniveervayu (Other Than Science Subjects), under Agniveervayu Intake 01/2027. content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies for Agniveervayu Intake 01/2027 at the Chumoukedima and Sri Vijaya Puram rallies is not specified in the official notification. Enrolment will be strictly in order of state-wise merit, subject to medical fitness, availability of state-wise vacancies, and meeting all eligibility criteria.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for this Open Recruitment Rally is based on date of birth, marital status, educational qualification, and domicile of the specified states/UTs. Candidates born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009 (both dates inclusive) are eligible to appear in this Open Recruitment Rally. If a candidate clears all stages of the selection procedure, the upper age limit as on the date of enrolment should not exceed 22 years. Only unmarried male and female candidates are eligible for enrolment as Agniveervayu. Candidates must undertake not to marry during the 4-year engagement period; those found married during this period shall be dismissed from service. Female candidates must also undertake not to become pregnant during the engagement period; pregnancy leading to Low Medical Category will result in dismissal from service and debars selection into the Regular Cadre. Candidates must satisfy one of the following educational qualifications: Passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent Examination in any stream/subjects from a Central/State/UT recognised Education Board, with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. OR passed a two-year Vocational Course from a recognised Education Board with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English in the Vocational Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation, if English is not a subject in the Vocational Course). OR passed a three-year Diploma Course in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/Information Technology) from a recognised Polytechnic Institute, with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English in the Diploma Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation, if English is not a subject in the Diploma Course). Note: The exact aggregate percentage before decimal, as written in the marksheet, is considered (for example, 49.99% is taken as 49% and is not rounded off to 50%). Candidates must hold permanent domicile of the districts of the State(s)/UT specified for the rally venue they wish to appear at (the North-Eastern states and Sikkim for Chumoukedima; the UT of Andaman & Nicobar Islands for Sri Vijaya Puram). A Domicile Certificate issued by a Gazetted Revenue Officer or authorised State/UT official is required, with the candidate's name and parent's name matching the matriculation certificate. Exceptions (COAFP-I and COAFP-II) apply to children of serving or retired/discharged/deceased Air Force personnel and Unit Cadre Civilians residing in or posted to the specified districts, subject to producing the relevant COAFP certificate or service documents.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Medical Standards
content_sections.text: Candidates undergoing gender reassignment surgery, or found pregnant (female candidates), or showing predominant characteristics of the opposite gender on external examination will be declared UNFIT. Consumption of narcotic drugs/psychotropic substances banned under the NDPS Act 1985 is a reject criterion, and the Indian Air Force follows a zero-tolerance policy on alcoholism and substance abuse.

Healthy gums, good set of teeth, minimum 14 dental points. Dental implants and fixed/removable orthodontic appliances are declared UNFIT.

Permanent tattoos are not permitted, except on the inner forearm, dorsal hand, or as per tribal custom/tradition (subject to selection centre discretion). Offensive, obscene, indecent, sexist, or racist tattoos anywhere on the body are prohibited.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for Agniveervayu Intake 01/2027 involves document verification followed by multiple test stages, all typically conducted over the rally days. Verification of Eligibility: Original/DigiLocker-verified educational certificates and other applicable documents (domicile, COAFP, NCC, discharge certificate, etc.) are scrutinised prior to the Physical Fitness Test. Physical Fitness Test (PFT): PFT-I: 1.6 Km run — male candidates within 7 minutes, female candidates within 8 minutes. PFT-II (after 10 minutes recuperation): Male candidates — 10 push-ups (1 min), 10 sit-ups (1 min), 20 squats (1 min), with rest breaks between exercises. Female candidates — 10 sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 squats (1 min), with rest breaks between exercises. Written Test: Objective type, bilingual (English & Hindi, except the English paper), duration 45 minutes, comprising English (20 questions, as per 10+2 CBSE syllabus) and Reasoning & General Awareness/RAGA (30 questions). Candidates must qualify each paper separately. Marking: +1 for each correct answer, 0 for unattempted questions, and -0.25 for each wrong answer or multiple-option answer. Results are declared the same day. Adaptability Test-I (AT-I): Objective written test assessing suitability for employment in varied geographic, weather, and operational conditions. Adaptability Test-II (AT-II): Assesses adaptability to Indian Air Force environment and military way of life; conducted the same or a subsequent day. Medical Examination: Conducted in September 2026 at Jorhat (for 11 ASC) and Sri Vijaya Puram (for 8 ASC), including baseline investigations such as blood haemogram, urine RE/ME, blood sugar, serum cholesterol, RFT, LFT, chest radiograph, ECG, and (for female candidates) ultrasonography of the lower abdomen and pelvis. Appeal Medical Board (AMB): Candidates declared medically unfit may appeal by depositing ₹40 via e-MRO/MRO within three working days of the medical examination. Provisional Select List and Enrolment: The state-wise Provisional Select List (PSL) is prepared based on performance and state-wise cut-offs and vacancies; inclusion in the PSL does not guarantee enrolment. The final Enrolment List is published after the PSL.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Salary and Pay Package
content_sections.text: Agniveervayu personnel are paid a customised Agniveer package that increases each year of the 4-year engagement, split between an in-hand component and a contribution to the Agniveer Corpus Fund (matched by the Government of India). In addition to the monthly package, Agniveervayu will receive Risk and Hardship allowances (as applicable in the Indian Air Force), Dress and Travel allowances, and perks such as ration, clothing, accommodation, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC). On completion of the 4-year engagement, Agniveervayu will receive a one-time Seva Nidhi package. The total contribution to the Agniveer Corpus Fund after 4 years is approximately ₹5.02 lakh from the candidate's monthly contributions, matched by approximately ₹5.02 lakh from the Government of India, resulting in an approximate Seva Nidhi payout of ₹10.04 lakh (absolute amount, excluding interest). Agniveervayu are not required to contribute to any Provident Fund and are not entitled to gratuity or pensionary benefits. Non-contributory Life Insurance cover of ₹48 lakh for the duration of the engagement period. Annual leave of 30 days per year; sick leave based on medical advice from a competent Medical Authority. Medical facility at service hospitals and CSD provisions during the engagement period. A detailed Agniveer Skill Certificate is provided at the end of the engagement, highlighting skills and competency acquired. Agniveervayu are not eligible for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) status after discharge on completion of the 4-year engagement. Up to 25% of each Agniveervayu batch may be offered an opportunity to apply for enrolment into the Regular Cadre as Airman, based on organisational requirements, performance, and objective criteria; there is no right to further enrolment.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee for the Open Recruitment Rally itself is specified in the official notification. A separate fee of ₹40 applies only if a candidate wishes to file an Appeal Medical Board (AMB) request after being declared medically unfit.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IAF Agniveervayu Rally
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry the following to the rally venue: HB pencil, eraser, sharpener, glue stick, stapler, and black & blue ball point pens. Ten un-attested recent passport-size colour photographs (front portrait, light background, without headgear except for Sikhs), holding a black slate with name and date of photograph in white chalk. Original or DigiLocker-verified printout and four self-attested photocopies of the matriculation passing certificate (for Date of Birth verification). Original or DigiLocker-verified printout and four self-attested photocopies of the 10+2/Intermediate/Diploma/Vocational course passing certificate and marksheet. Original and four self-attested photocopies of the Domicile Certificate, or the applicable COAFP-I/COAFP-II certificate/service documents. NOC in original and four self-attested photocopies from the employer, for candidates currently serving in a government organisation (if applicable). Original and four self-attested photocopies of Discharge Certificate, for candidates discharged from the Indian Army/Indian Navy/any government organisation (if applicable). Body tattoo photographs (two postcard-size photographs, close-up and distant view), if applicable. Original and four self-attested photocopies of NCC 'A', 'B', or 'C' Certificate (if applicable). Completed Consent Form for Physical Fitness Test and Medical Tests (signed by the candidate if 18+, or by parent/guardian if under 18). Aadhaar Card as proof of identity (candidates from J&K, Ladakh, Assam, and Meghalaya without Aadhaar may carry any other valid photo ID). Note: Candidates cannot appear in the rally without original educational certificates and the documents listed above, except where a College/Institution Principal's certificate confirms the originals are deposited with the institution, or where DigiLocker-verified certificates are produced with an accessible mobile device for verification. Internet copies or mobile-photo printouts of marksheets are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Report for IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment Rally 2026
content_sections.text: This is an Open Recruitment Rally (walk-in), not a portal-based online application. The official notification specifies only the reporting requirement at the rally venue; no separate online registration process is described in this document. Confirm eligibility for date of birth, marital status, qualification, domicile, and medical standards as detailed above. Report to the applicable rally venue (Chumoukedima or Sri Vijaya Puram) on the scheduled reporting date for your category (women/men), by the 10 AM cut-off time. Carry all original documents and photocopies listed in the "Documents Required" section, along with the completed Consent Form. Undergo document verification, followed by the Physical Fitness Test, Written Test, Adaptability Tests, and Medical Examination as per the selection procedure. Check https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in regularly for the Provisional Select List, Enrolment List, and any corrigendum/updates.

faq.question: Q1. What is IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment Rally 2026?
faq.answer: It is an Open Recruitment Rally conducted by the Indian Air Force from 31 August to 07 September 2026 to select unmarried male and female candidates for Agniveervayu (Other Than Science Subjects) under Intake 01/2027, at Chumoukedima (Nagaland) and Sri Vijaya Puram (Andaman & Nicobar Islands).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under Agniveervayu Intake 01/2027?
faq.answer: The number of vacancies is not specified in the official notification. Enrolment will be based on state-wise merit and state-wise vacancy availability.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009 (both dates inclusive). The upper age limit as on the date of enrolment should not exceed 22 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for IAF Agniveervayu (Other Than Science Subjects)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2/Intermediate/Equivalent in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate and 50% in English, or a two-year Vocational Course, or a three-year Engineering Diploma in specified trades, each with the same minimum percentage criteria.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to appear at the Chumoukedima and Sri Vijaya Puram rallies?
faq.answer: Candidates with permanent domicile of the districts of Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, and Sikkim are eligible for the Chumoukedima rally, while candidates with permanent domicile of the districts of the UT of Andaman & Nicobar Islands are eligible for the Sri Vijaya Puram rally. Certain children of Air Force personnel (COAFP-I/COAFP-II) are also eligible irrespective of domicile, subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee for the rally itself is specified in the official notification. Only the Appeal Medical Board process carries a fee of ₹40.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection includes document verification, a Physical Fitness Test (1.6 Km run, push-ups, sit-ups, squats), a written test (English and Reasoning & General Awareness), Adaptability Test-I, Adaptability Test-II, and a medical examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for IAF Agniveervayu?
faq.answer: Agniveervayu receive a monthly customised package starting at ₹30,000 in the 1st year and rising to ₹40,000 in the 4th year, plus Risk and Hardship, Dress, and Travel allowances, and other perks. A one-time Seva Nidhi package of approximately ₹10.04 lakh is paid on completion of the 4-year engagement.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment Rally 2026?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in Open Recruitment Rally. Eligible candidates should report directly to the applicable rally venue on their scheduled reporting date with all required original documents; no separate online application process is mentioned in this notification.

faq.question: Q10. When will the Provisional Select List and Enrolment List be published?
faq.answer: The Provisional Select List is tentatively scheduled for 14 November 2026, and the Enrolment List is tentatively scheduled for 01 December 2026.
